name: funes-omp
description: omp extension: recall over past AI-assistant sessions bridged to `funes mcp`, and per-turn indexing of the session into that memory.

scripts.build: sh -c 'rm -rf .build && mkdir -p .build && node build/splice.mjs build .build/index.ts >/dev/null && cmp .build/index.ts index.ts'
scripts.check: npm run build && sh test/run.sh node
